HouseTask
agents:
	humans: human1
	robots: robot1
locations: bedroom, kitchen
resources: object

human1:
	1: moveTo bedroom
	2: skip if !possess(robot1, object)
	3: moveTo kitchen

robot1:
	1: moveTo bedroom
	2: skip if !position(human1, bedroom)
	3: pick object
	4: follow human1(kitchen)

success: position(human1, kitchen) && position(robot1, kitchen) && possess(robot1, object)
